description: The plot illustrates the ASR across a sequence of categorical variables for three different conditions. The x-axis displays categorical data with the labels "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and features a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, with visible values ranging from 0.2 to 0.8. The "start" condition is represented by a solid green line with dot markers; it begins at approximately 0.73 at "bb", experiences a sharp decline to its lowest point of roughly 0.16 at "mb", and then generally trends upward, reaching about 0.80 at "beautiful" and peaking at approximately 0.94 at the final category, "beautifully". The "random" condition is shown as a solid orange line with 'x' markers, starting at roughly 0.12 at "bb", dipping slightly to about 0.09 at "mb", and then following an upward trend to reach approximately 0.62 at "beautiful", peaking at about 0.93 at "stunning", and ending at roughly 0.85 at "beautifully". The "end" condition is depicted by a solid purple line with circle markers, which starts at 0.40 at "bb", spikes to approximately 0.89 at "cf", drops to roughly 0.62 at "beautiful", fluctuates to reach another peak of about 0.92 at "wonderful", and concludes at approximately 0.91 at "beautifully".
